methods.label: Multiply by the missing factors
methods.explanation: The least common denominator is \(x(x+1)\). Multiplying both the numerator and denominator of \(1/x\) by \(x+1\) gives \((x+1)/[x(x+1)]\). Multiplying both the numerator and denominator of \(1/(x+1)\) by \(x\) gives \(x/[x(x+1)]\).
